title: Optimal check weight for two-logical-qubit codes of lengths eleven and twelve
statement: W_opt(11,2,d>=4)=W_opt(12,2,d>=4)=5, for arbitrary binary stabilizer codes and generating bases.
scope: Both finite parameter cells, not the general asymptotic problem.
review: Sequential internal proof review with three separately implemented classification calculations; not independent expert review.
priority: Difference supported against checked sources; worldwide priority not certified.
